name: image-reveal

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the list with a clear revealed photo beside the hovered row; frame 1 shows no image at all.

tagline: Hover a large word and a photo springs up beside the pointer.
summary: Four oversized text rows, each with a small category tag, that fade in a related photo while the pointer is on them. The picture follows the cursor and vanishes when you leave.
appearance: Four oversized white labels stacked with thin divider lines, each with a tiny category word and square marker at the far right. A small rounded photo can appear wherever the pointer is over the list.
behaviour: Hovering a row fades in the photo tied to that row; the picture springs toward the cursor as it moves and fades out when the pointer leaves the list.
demo_content: Labels Stay Confident, Create Your Space, Be Yourself, Live Inspired with Style, Design, Identity and Lifestyle tags
search_phrases: list of words that reveals pictures
hover text to show an image
image that follows the cursor over rows
big type list with hidden images
move over headings to see photos
use_when: Editorial links deserve a preview image without a thumbnail grid.
avoid_when: Hover only, so touch users never see a preview; every photo is a remote Unsplash URL.
customise: The four labels, tags and image URLs are a hardcoded array; spring stiffness and image size are fixed in the file.
weight_why: Four rows and one spring-tracked image; nothing runs when idle.

a11y.note: Rows are divs with hover-only handlers; keyboard and screen-reader users get no preview or link.

issues: Rows are not links or buttons, so nothing can be opened or tabbed to.
In frame 4 the preview is blurred while spring-tracking, so it is briefly unreadable.
polish_why: Confident oversized type and a playful cursor-following preview; hover-only access is the main gap.
